stages.title: VISUAL GATEWAY — THE THREE FUNCTIONS
stages.terms: Visual gateway — the three functions: Final verdict: Reason is best treated as regulative without being assumed to be the sole source of religious truth.
stages.mechanism: Recommended opening definition: Reason tests coherence and warrant, revelation claims divine self-disclosure, and faith receives that disclosure through trust and commitment.
stages.consequence: Core argument/criticism: Propositional models emphasise revealed truths, whereas non-propositional models emphasise divine acts or presence interpreted through human experience.
stages.trap: Master verdict: Reason should be regulative but need not be constitutive.
stages.answer: Master verdict: Reason should be regulative but need not be constitutive.
